fields.System.Title: OUT-1 — Orders
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Accept an order, validate it, expose its state, and allow it to be cancelled or amended
cleanly.

Scope

In. Order creation via API and from the ERP, validation, status query, cancellation,
pre-allocation amendment.

Out. Pricing, credit checks, and customer communication. The ERP owns the commercial side.

Design notes

OUT-104 is the highest-risk story in this feature, which surprises people who expect
cancellation to be a status update.

Cancelling must release every reservation, in the same transaction, from every entry point —
API cancel, ERP cancel, wave cancellation, timeout. Miss one and reserved stock accumulates
silently, availability decays over months, and eventually someone finds a product with 500 on
hand and 12 available.

Deduplicate ERP orders on the external reference. A retried message must create one order,
not two, or the customer receives two deliveries.

Amendment is only legal before allocation. After that, deallocate first
([OUT-206](../../stories/OUT/OUT-206-deallocate-order-line.md)), then amend. Editing an
allocated line leaves reservations pointing at quantities that no longer exist.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Reservations not released on cancel | [doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| ERP retry creating a duplicate order | [doc 09 §3.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Amending an allocated line | [doc 09 §5.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
